title: SpaceX and Tesla Discuss Potential Merger
excerpt: Special committees have been formed at SpaceX and Tesla to discuss a possible merger, though Elon Musk notes it is not guaranteed.
body_html:
SpaceX and Tesla are currently exploring the possibility of a merger between the two companies. According to reports, special committees have been established to discuss the potential combination.

However, Elon Musk has indicated that the merger is not a certainty.
